description: This file defines an abstract class RpcHandler for handling RPC messages in Apache Spark's network server module. It includes methods for receiving RPCs, handling streams, managing channel states, and processing specific request types like MergedBlockMetaRequest.

classes.name: RpcHandler
classes.description: Abstract class for handling RPC messages, including methods for receiving messages, streams, and managing channel states.

classes.name: RpcHandler.NoopMergedBlockMetaReqHandler
classes.description: No-operation implementation of MergedBlockMetaReqHandler that does nothing.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Abstract method to handle a single RPC message.

methods.name: receiveStream
methods.description: Method to handle an RPC message with streaming data; throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

methods.name: getStreamManager
methods.description: Abstract method to get the StreamManager managing current streams.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Method to handle a one-way RPC message without expecting a reply.

methods.name: getMergedBlockMetaReqHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler for MergedBlockMetaRequest messages.

methods.name: channelActive
methods.description: Invoked when a channel becomes active.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Invoked when a channel becomes inactive.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions caught during RPC processing.
